correctness.rationale: Using z(root)=u-v, z(leaf)=v forces mean(u)=0 and gives exact 2×2 Fourier symbols (A,E;E,L) for nonzero frequencies plus L_0. At p=1 E=0, L=-2, and exact cycle Fourier eigenvalues have zeros for even n and strict negative modes for odd. Li–Weston strict-exponent implication excludes p>1 for even; odd strictness and p=2 L_0=2(n-2)>0 put wp in (1,2). For p=1+c/n², uniform Taylor expansion, bounded-variation 1/k Fourier tail, and E=O(log n/n), L=-2+O(log n/n²) show first even mode k=2 controls threshold c*=2pi²/Cin(2pi). Independent full distance-eigenvalue comparisons checked n=3,5,7,9,11,13 at p=0,1,1.05 and numerical odd n=31,71,131 scaled cutoff approaching constant; finite checks not asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: Uniform-in-k remainder of scaling argument is essential; finite spectral testing alone insufficient.
